seo.title: Steel Fishing Vessel Design | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: Steel fishing vessel design for offshore fishing and support vessels: drawings, stability and structural calculations, and approval documents.

fields.headline: Steel fishing vessel design: drawings, calculations and approval documents
fields.lead: New-build design for offshore steel fishing vessels and fishery support vessels — from main dimensions and hull lines to the document set for plan approval.

items.problem: A new vessel, but no concept yet
items.context: You know the fishery, the size range and the operating area.
items.solution: We propose main dimensions, general arrangement and engine power, and write the design brief.

items.problem: Documents keep coming back for revision
items.context: Missing calculations or drawings that do not match the rules.
items.solution: We review the set, add stability, structure and machinery calculations, and fix the drawings.

items.context: A larger engine, new equipment or a changed hold layout.
items.solution: We re-check stability, resistance and power, propeller and shafting, and update the drawings.

fields.heading: What you receive
fields.intro: A complete design set for building and plan approval.
fields.note: Lead time is agreed with the quote, depending on vessel type, scope and existing documents. You know each delivery date in advance.

items.title: Technical drawings
items.desc: Lines plan, general arrangement, structure, machinery, systems

items.title: Calculations and reports
items.desc: Hydrostatics, stability, freeboard, structure, resistance and power, propeller, shafting

items.title: Approval documents
items.desc: All items required for plan review

items.title: Support during review
items.desc: We revise until the documents are approved

steps.title: Send us the brief
steps.desc: Vessel type, target dimensions, operating area and any photos or documents you have.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.desc: We agree the scope, deliverables and schedule, with a clear price for each part.

steps.title: Design and calculations
steps.desc: Drawings and calculations with industry software and our own engineering tools.

steps.title: Review and handover
steps.desc: We answer the reviewer’s comments, update the documents and hand over the final set.

items.title: We have no drawings yet — where do we start?
items.content: Tell us the fishery, target size, operating area and budget. We propose a concept and write the design brief.

items.title: How long does the design take?
items.content: It depends on size, how complete the requirements are and the documents you already have. Each delivery date is agreed with the quote.

fields.heading: Planning a steel fishing vessel?
fields.description: Call us with the fishery, vessel size and operating area. We reply with a concept and a clear quote.
